label: Closed-collection rootedness of actual grounding
definition: Over the #505 Profile, a collection S of candidates is ground-closed at w (GroundClosedActual m w S) when every member of S is an actual concretum at w and every actual concrete ground at w of a member of S is itself in S. ClosedGroundingCollectionsRooted m w holds when no ground-closed collection is both nonempty and without an actual root (ActualRoot: an actual concretum with no actual concrete ground at w); in Lean, every ground-closed collection all of whose members have an actual concrete ground is empty. Ordinary meaning: if you collect actual concrete things together with every actual concrete thing that gives being to any of them (in the selected direct relation), and keep doing so, the collection must contain something to which no actual concrete thing gives being. Such a member may still have an abstract or unmodelled ground: the closure is over actual concrete grounds only. Orientation example (not warrant): a lamp lit by a wire powered by a generator turned by a falling river; collecting each supplier of each member, the collection is rooted only if it reaches something nothing in it supplies. Counterexamples to the condition (formal only): a pure endless descent n+1 grounds n (Control.pureRegress) and a pure cycle with nothing outside it. Non-counterexamples: an endless descending chain all of whose members are also directly grounded by one root (Control.limitGrounder, a direct root grounder despite its name), and a cycle grounded by a root (Control.rootedCycle). Control.mediateFoundation encodes an isolated root alongside a rootless regress, which violates the condition. A genuine mediated foundation remains an unresolved interpretation requiring additional structure; absence of direct root edges alone establishes neither mediated support nor failure of CCR. Distinguished from well-foundedness (STMT-ACTUAL-GROUNDING-WF), which says every nonempty collection, closed or not, has a member with no ground inside it: well-foundedness implies the condition (closedRootedOfWF) but not conversely. Distinguished from asymmetry (no two actual concreta ground each other), which it does not imply, and from the existence of some actual root, which it implies only with inhabitedness and excluded middle (actualRootOfClosedRooted). Structural properties: it imposes no transitivity, asymmetry, irreflexivity or uniform path-length bound on grounding; proposed finite root accessibility is a derived equivalence awaiting certification.
note: Analyst framework definition, attribution deferred (#310). It is the weakest no-regress condition that the coverage routes of the stage-one join consume. It is not the borrowed-reality principle itself: that principle quantifies over all suppliers (NoWhollyBorrowedCollection, over every modelled actual supplier), The registered theorem derives CCR under supplier concreteness (ActualSuppliersOfConcretaConcrete; closedRootedOfBorrowed); borrowed reality alone does not imply CCR (Control.abstractSupplier). Weaker sufficient bridges remain under investigation. It is relative to the profile's selected direct relation, which is not identified with efficient causing (DEF-PRESENT-ESSE-SUPPORT); whether any real relation satisfies it is open. Dependencies: DEF-ACTUAL-GROUNDING-WF for ActualConcrete, the ActualConcreteGround and ActualRoot predicates of the brute-root vocabulary. Generalizing from ordinary supply chains to metaphysical sustaining is an explicit open bridge. Sourced readings (Aquinas's reduction of what is by participation to what is by essence; Cameron 2008 on foundations reached through intermediaries, which the isolated-root control does not encode) are unread leads, not attributions. Follow-up application and warrant audit (proposed, pending parent semantic challenge): docs/notes/direct-grounding-warrant.md. In particular, mediateFoundation encodes no edge from its isolated root; a genuine mediate-foundation interpretation requires additional structure.
